raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What does this PR do?

Port #6427 and #6447 from `r0.7.0` to `main` so the `fw-final` image installs cuDNN Frontend from pinned commit `8924d4b41fd678ba1b98cd7f98bb78b222637573` on `feat/1.29.0-megatron`. Without the follow-up fix, the framework's dependency override replaces the explicit Git requirement with the registry wheel.

## Changelog

- Add the Docker-only `CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF` build argument and document it.
- Skip cuDNN Frontend during the framework sync, install the Git requirement with `--no-config`, and fail the build if the installed distribution does not record the requested commit.
- Preserve registry-wheel behavior when the argument is empty and base-runtime preservation when enabled.

## GitHub Actions CI

Validated in an isolated Linux container with Python 3.12 and `UV_NO_SYNC=1`:

- `uv run python -m pytest -q --confcutdir=tests/unit_tests/docker tests/unit_tests/docker/test_preserve_base_runtime.py` — 16 passed. The directory cutoff isolates these dependency-free tests from the GPU training fixtures.
- `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

A full `fw-final` image rebuild has not been run for this port.

## Before your PR is "Ready for review"

- [x] Read and followed the contributor guidelines.
- [x] Ran the existing relevant tests; this is an exact port of the two merged changes.
- [x] Updated the Docker build-argument documentation.
- Optional-import guards: not applicable; no Python APIs or dependency manifests change.

## Additional Information

Related to #6427 and #6447. This is separate from #6430's registry-wheel upgrade to 1.31.0: the default Git install takes precedence in `fw-final`; an empty `CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF` keeps registry behavior.

detail.title: fix(build): install pinned cuDNN Frontend Git ref in fw-final

files.patch:
@@ -57,6 +57,11 @@ RUN    pushd /opt/Export-Deploy && \
         echo "Container built with NeMo-Run commit hash: $NEMO_RUN_COMMIT" && \
     popd
 
+# cuDNN Frontend is replaced after the sync below with this ref of NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend
+# (feat/1.29.0-megatron). Docker-only: outside fw_pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Set empty to keep the
+# PyPI wheel.
+ARG CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF=8924d4b41fd678ba1b98cd7f98bb78b222637573
+
 # Sync environment
 COPY --chmod=644 docker/common/fw_pyproject.toml /opt/NeMo-FW/pyproject.toml
 COPY --chmod=644 docker/common/_version.py docker/common/print_sha.sh /opt/NeMo-FW/
@@ -67,8 +72,16 @@ RUN \
     BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS="" && \
     if [ "${MBRIDGE_PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME:-False}" = "True" ]; then \
         BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS="--no-install-package nvidia-cudnn-frontend --no-install-package transformer-engine --no-install-package transformer-engine-torch"; \
+    elif [ -n "$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" ]; then \
+        BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS="--no-install-package nvidia-cudnn-frontend"; \
     fi && \
     uv sync --no-cache-dir --all-groups --inexact ${BASE_RUNTIME_UV_ARGS} && \
+    if [ -n "$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" ] && [ "${MBRIDGE_PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME:-False}" != "True" ]; then \
+        uv pip install --no-config --no-cache-dir --no-deps --reinstall \
+            "nvidia-cudnn-frontend @ git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend.git@${CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF}" && \
+        CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF="$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" python -c \
+            'import importlib.metadata as m, json, os, sys; source = m.distribution("nvidia-cudnn-frontend").read_text("direct_url.json"); sys.exit(0 if json.loads(source)["vcs_info"]["commit_id"] == os.environ["CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF"] else "cuDNN Frontend Git ref mismatch")'; \
+    fi && \
     python /opt/preserve_base_runtime.py check /opt/base-runtime-packages.json && \
     uv pip list && \
     chmod +x print_sha.sh && \

@@ -250,6 +250,7 @@ docker build \
 | `NEMO_EXPORT_DEPLOY_COMMIT` | NeMo Export-Deploy git commit SHA |
 | `NEMO_EVALUATOR_COMMIT` | NeMo Evaluator git commit SHA |
 | `NEMO_RUN_COMMIT` | NeMo Run git commit SHA |
+| `CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF` | Commit of [NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend) (`feat/1.29.0-megatron`) installed over the PyPI cuDNN frontend after the environment sync; empty keeps the PyPI wheel. Docker-only, outside `fw_pyproject.toml`; skipped when `PRESERVE_BASE_RUNTIME=True`. |
 
 ---
